This integration brings your **MyFoncia** account (Foncia, property management:
co-ownership and rentals) into Gladys: account balance, next amount due, open
incidents, new documents and the next general assembly. It also adds scene
triggers, scene actions and a dashboard widget.

> Unofficial integration. Foncia publishes no API: the integration reads your
> account the way the my-foncia.fonciamillenium.net web site does. If Foncia changes its site,
> the integration may stop working until it is updated.

## Requirements

- Gladys Assistant **5.3** or later.
- A MyFoncia account (e-mail and password) **without a second factor** (SMS or
  app code at each sign-in): the integration cannot answer it.
- Internet access for Gladys. This is a **cloud** integration: nothing runs on
  your local network.

## Configuration

| Field               | What to enter                                                                       |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| MyFoncia e-mail     | The e-mail you sign in with on my-foncia.fonciamillenium.net.                       |
| MyFoncia password   | Your password. Stored by Gladys as a secret, only sent to Foncia's sign-in page.    |
| Sync interval (min) | How often MyFoncia is read. 60 by default, 15 minimum.                              |
| Due reminder (days) | How many days before a due date the "Payment due soon" trigger fires. 7 by default. |
| Advanced settings   | Leave empty, see [Advanced settings](#advanced-settings).                           |

Then press **Test the connection**: the message lists the accounts found. **Sync
now** reads MyFoncia right away.

## Devices

One Gladys device per MyFoncia account (one lot of a co-ownership, one rental),
named `Foncia – <account>`. Create it from the **Discover** tab. Its features are
read-only and keep their history:

| Feature                         | Unit | Meaning                                                            |
| ------------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Account balance                 | €    | As shown by MyFoncia (negative: you owe money).                    |
| Next amount due                 | €    | Amount of the next call for funds or rent.                         |
| Days until the due date         | days | Negative once the date has passed.                                 |
| Open incidents                  | —    | Requests to Foncia (repairs, incidents, questions) not closed yet. |
| New documents                   | —    | Documents added since you last marked them as seen.                |
| Days until the general assembly | days | Next general assembly of the co-ownership.                         |

The badge of the device says **cloud**, or **unreachable** when the last sync failed.

## Scene triggers

Fired only for what is **new**: the first sync after installing only learns what
already exists. At most 5 events of each kind per sync, so a scene that sends a
notification per document never floods your phone.

| Trigger                    | Filters                | Variables                            |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| New Foncia document        | account, document type | account, title, date                 |
| Foncia incident updated    | account, new status    | account, title, previous status      |
| Payment due soon           | account                | account, amount, due date, days left |
| General assembly announced | account                | account, title, date, days left      |

Document types: call for funds, general assembly, statement of charges, invoice
or receipt, other. Incident statuses: open, in progress, closed.

Example: _"When a new Foncia document of type **call for funds** arrives, send
me a message: New call for funds: \{\{triggerEvent.data.title\}\}"_.

## Scene actions

- **Sync Foncia**: reads MyFoncia now and gives the next actions the figures of
  one account (empty = the first one): success, account, balance, amount due,
  due date, open incidents, new documents.
- **Mark Foncia documents as seen**: sets the "New documents" counter back to 0
  (for one account, or all of them).

## Dashboard widget

**Foncia account**: balance, amount due (0 € when nothing is due), last payment and new documents,
connection and last sync, next due date and next general assembly, the five
latest documents, and two buttons: **Sync now** and **Mark as seen**. In its
settings, pick the account to show (empty = the first one).

A dash (—) means MyFoncia could not be read: see the integration logs.

## Privacy

- The password is only sent to Foncia's sign-in page (`login.my-foncia.fonciamillenium.net`).
  It is never written in the logs.
- The access tokens stay in memory. The only file written is
  `/data/foncia-state.json`: the ids of the documents, incidents and meetings
  already seen, so that no trigger fires twice after a restart.

## Troubleshooting

| Message                                     | What to do                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| MyFoncia refused the e-mail or the password | Check them by signing in on my-foncia.fonciamillenium.net.                  |
| asks for a second factor                    | Not supported: the account needs a code at each sign-in.                    |
| The MyFoncia account is locked              | Unlock it on my-foncia.fonciamillenium.net, then press Test the connection. |
| The MyFoncia client id is missing           | See [Advanced settings](#advanced-settings).                                |
| MyFoncia cannot be reached                  | Check the Internet access of Gladys.                                        |
| MyFoncia answered with an error             | Look at the integration logs; Foncia may have changed its site.             |

## Advanced settings

The integration signs in and reads your account with the same settings as the
MyFoncia web site: its Okta **client id** and the address of its **API**. Both
are built in: leave the two fields empty.

If one day Foncia changes them and every sync fails with an API error, read the
new values in [https://my-foncia.fonciamillenium.net/config.js](https://my-foncia.fonciamillenium.net/config.js): `clientId`
under `oktaConfig` is the **Okta client id**, `url` under `graphql` is the
**MyFoncia API URL**. Enter them in the advanced settings, save, then press
**Test the connection**. Please also open an issue on the repository so that the
built-in values can be updated for everyone.

## Configuration settings

These are the settings Foncia asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Getting started | `section` | No | Enter the e-mail and password you use on my-foncia.fonciamillenium.net. The integration reads your account every hour: one Gladys device per account, with its balance, the next amount due, the open incidents and the new documents. Accounts protected by a second factor (SMS, app) are not supported. |
| MyFoncia e-mail | `string` | Yes |  |
| MyFoncia password | `secret` | Yes |  |
| Sync interval (min) | `number` | No | How often MyFoncia is read, in minutes (15 minimum). |
| Due reminder (days) | `number` | No | The "Payment due" scene trigger fires this many days before a due date. |
| Advanced settings | `section` | No | Built in: leave these fields empty. Only fill them in if Foncia changes its settings (see the documentation). |
| Okta client id | `string` | No |  |
| MyFoncia API URL | `string` | No |  |

## How to install Foncia in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: Foncia appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/prohand/gladys-foncia:2.0.0`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/prohand/gladys-foncia](https://github.com/prohand/gladys-foncia).

Foncia requires Gladys `>=5.3.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations

Foncia is an **external integration**: a community integration packaged as a Docker container and published on GitHub, that Gladys installs in one click and runs in a sandbox isolated from its core. It is published and maintained by [prohand](https://github.com/prohand), not by the Gladys core team.
